bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 61
rollback="$HOME/.local/state/tgtumbler/bugreport-ipc-hotfix-20261115"
mkdir -p "$rollback"
chmod 700 "$rollback"
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, ast
p=Path("scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py")
src=p.read_text()
needle='ACTIONS = frozenset({'
anchor='    if action == "room_private_smoke":'
if src.count(needle)!=1 or src.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit(62)
if 'if action == "report_recipient_id":' in src: raise SystemExit(63)
new=src.replace(needle,needle+'"report_recipient_id", ',1)
block='''    if action == "report_recipient_id":
        if set(request) != {"request_id", "action"}:
            raise ValueError("REQUEST_SHAPE_INVALID")
        account = await client.get_me()
        if not account or getattr(account, "bot", False) or not isinstance(getattr(account, "id", None), int) or account.id <= 0:
            raise RuntimeError("REPORT_RECIPIENT_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED")
        return {"request_id": request_id, "action": action, "status": "PASS", "recipient_id": account.id}
'''
new=new.replace(anchor,block+anchor,1)
ast.parse(new)
backup=Path.home()/".local/state/tgtumbler/bugreport-ipc-hotfix-20261115/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
if backup.exists(): raise SystemExit(64)
backup.write_text(src)
os.chmod(backup,0o600)
tmp=p.with_name(".userbot_resident_ipc.bugreport.tmp")
with tmp.open("x") as f:f.write(new)
os.chmod(tmp,p.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print("IPC_REPORT_PATCH=APPLIED")
PY
python3 -m py_compile scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || exit 65
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from types import SimpleNamespace
from userbot_resident_ipc import process_request
class Fake:
 async def is_user_authorized(self):return True
 async def get_me(self):return SimpleNamespace(id=123456789,bot=False)
r=asyncio.run(process_request(Fake(),{"request_id":"test-recipient","action":"report_recipient_id"}))
assert r["status"]=="PASS" and r["recipient_id"]==123456789
print("IPC_REPORT_MOCK=PASS")
PY
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 66
sleep 5
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio,os,pathlib,stat,sys
from userbot_test_client import invoke
from userbot_session import SESSION_BASE
session=SESSION_BASE.with_suffix(".session")
if not session.is_file() or session.is_symlink() or stat.S_IMODE(session.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(68)
health=asyncio.run(invoke("health"))
if health.get("status")!="PASS" or health.get("authorized") is not True:sys.exit(69)
r=asyncio.run(invoke("report_recipient_id"))
recipient=r.get("recipient_id")
if r.get("status")!="PASS" or type(recipient)!=int or not 10000<=recipient<2**53:sys.exit(70)
target=pathlib.Path("deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt")
if target.is_symlink():sys.exit(71)
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
fd=os.open(target,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as f:
 f.write(str(recipient)+"\n")
 f.flush()
 os.fsync(f.fileno())
if stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(72)
print("USERBOT_RECIPIENT_SECRET=PASS")
print("USERBOT_AUTH=PASS")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 73
echo USERBOT_REPORT_PRIVATE_RECIPIENT=READY
